steps.title: Roll the complete item
steps.action: Buy the specified uninfluenced, uncorrupted rare base; use Deafening Essence of Greed. Preserve any required existing links, quality and native implicits. No fracture, metacraft or bench finish is assumed.
steps.continueWhen: All requirements together: Maximum Life >= 91; Level of all Minion Skill Gems >= 1; Fire Resistance >= 30; Implicit Increased Minion Damage >= 20. Stop on this complete result.
steps.failureAction: If any required random modifier is missing, repeat the paid essence on the same base. Each repeat removes all previous non-fractured explicit and crafted modifiers. Stop spending when your budget is exhausted; do not use a safety Annul trick.
